tui.help.getting_started:
Getting started: your first stream

1. Sign in and set up your room
Scan the QR code in Accounts, then set a title and category in Room.

2. Connect OBS
Open OBS and prepare your picture and audio. In Tools > WebSocket Server Settings, enable the server and open Show Connect Info to find the password. Enter it on this app's OBS page and choose Connect OBS.

3. Go live
On the OBS page, enable Start OBS streaming when going live. In Live, choose Start live and confirm. Open your live room to check picture and sound.

4. Stop
In Live, choose Stop Bilibili live and confirm.

Video tutorial
https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1VbeN6tEtn
tui.help.obs:
OBS connection and password

Where do I find the password?
In OBS Studio, open Tools > WebSocket Server Settings > Show Connect Info. Use the server password shown there. Do not enter your Bilibili login password or stream key. If the menu is missing, update OBS to a version with WebSocket v5 support.

Which address should I enter?
For OBS on this computer, use ws://127.0.0.1:4455 with the port shown in OBS. For another computer, use that computer's reachable address and its WebSocket port. Enable the server in OBS and check firewall access. Do not expose OBS control to untrusted networks.

Why does connection fail?
Check that OBS is running, its WebSocket server is enabled, and the address, port, and password match. Authentication errors usually require correcting the password. After changing the URL or password in this app, choose Connect OBS again: changing either disconnects the old session. Check Logs for the reported error.

What do the two switches do?
Auto-connect connects OBS on launch or when starting live. Auto-stream starts OBS streaming when you start live and requires an OBS connection. When OBS is connected, Start live configures its streaming destination regardless of Auto-stream.

Does disconnecting stop the broadcast?
No. Disconnect OBS releases control only. Use Stop Bilibili live to stop the broadcast, or stop streaming in OBS. Check the status afterward.
tui.help.stream:
Live, but no picture or stream

The room says Live. Why is there no video?
Bilibili opening the room and OBS sending video are separate steps. Read the last result message and open OBS. If Auto-stream was off, start streaming in OBS after the app configures it. Check the OBS preview and audio meters, then open the Bilibili viewer page.

The app says OBS integration failed after live started. What now?
The room may already be live. Refresh its status and read Logs for the OBS error. Check the OBS connection and streaming settings. Do not repeatedly start live without checking both states. You can stop the room, fix the connection, and then start again.

OBS is streaming, but the viewer sees a black screen or hears nothing.
Check the active OBS scene, source visibility, capture permissions, and audio mixer. If OBS itself has no picture or sound, fix those sources there. If its preview is correct, check OBS streaming errors and the destination, then reload the viewer page.

OBS is reconnecting or refuses the destination.
Check the network and the OBS error. The Settings page offers streaming protocol and proxy options; choose a supported protocol. If the app refuses to replace an active destination, stop streaming in OBS first, then retry Start live. Changing application settings alone does not verify OBS's network connection.

Can I configure OBS manually?
If you deliberately do not use OBS control, turn off Auto-connect and Auto-stream. After starting live, use Show / Hide stream key in Live to see the returned destination and key and enter them in OBS as required by that protocol. Hide them afterward and never include them in screenshots or shared logs.
tui.help.chat:
Chat and local history

Why are no new messages appearing?
Check the active account and room, and ensure chat listening is enabled. Look at the connection status; use Retry after a connection error. A quiet room may have no new events. A paused history view or an event filter can also hide incoming messages from the current view.

How do I read older messages without losing my place?
Use the chat page's history controls and room selector. Pause following to read older records; return to the latest messages when you want the view to follow again. Reading another room's saved history does not change your active Bilibili account.

Does history include everything from Bilibili?
Local history contains events this app received, not a complete archive of the room. Messages missed while the app was closed or listening was disabled are not guaranteed to appear. Records older than seven days are cleaned automatically.

Why do the overlay and speech differ from this list?
Overlay and TTS have their own event selections. Check those pages separately. Changing which local history room you browse does not redirect the live listener.

How do I remove local history?
Settings > Clear application data removes all chat history, logs, settings, and saved login information, then exits. This is not a history-only action; read the confirmation before entering the required text.
tui.help.output:
Overlay and speech questions

Why is the overlay not visible?
Open Overlay, enable it, and check the selected displays and appearance settings. Make sure chat listening is enabled and the active room is receiving events. Open Select events to check that the events you want are included.

Why is TTS silent?
Open TTS, enable speech, choose an available voice, and check the volume. Try the voice preview and check the computer's audio output. If preview works but live events are silent, check chat listening and the TTS event selection.

Can I choose different events for overlay and speech?
Yes. Open Select events on each page. Enter or Space toggles and saves the selected event; Esc returns. Overlay and TTS selections are saved separately.

Where do I change the voice or stop speech?
Use the voice and volume controls on TTS. Stop speech interrupts current speech; use the speech switch if you want to disable subsequent speech too.

Why is output still Chinese when the interface is English?
The overlay content and speech templates support Chinese. Changing the interface language does not translate received messages or these templates.
tui.help.controls:
Keyboard, mouse, and settings

How do I navigate?
Tab / Shift+Tab or Left / Right changes the main page. Number keys 1 through 9 open pages directly; 0 opens Help. Use Up / Down to select an action and Enter to open it. Dialogs show their own controls; Esc returns or cancels. Input fields and chat controls may use keys differently, so follow the visible hints.

What can I do with the mouse?
Click a page or action to open it. Use the wheel to scroll content and the on-screen back control to leave an article or dialog. Moving the pointer over an action highlights it without activating it.

Where are appearance and connection settings?
Settings contains theme, appearance, proxy, and streaming protocol options. OBS has its own connection address, password, and automatic behavior switches. Saved preferences remain in effect when you reopen the app.

What happens when I exit?
By default, the app stops OBS streaming and closes the current account's Bilibili live room, including a room started by another client. The two exit switches in Settings are independent. Stopping OBS streaming does not quit OBS Studio. Turning both off leaves streaming and the room running; it does not change the Live page's Stop action.

What is the difference between reset and clear data?
Restore default settings resets application preferences, overlay, TTS voice, and event selections, and stops overlay and speech. It keeps OBS configuration and Bilibili login information. Clear application data removes settings, chat history, logs, and login information and then exits. Read its confirmation carefully.
